calls.content:
"""生成并核对发布产物：out/rollout.csv 与 release_note.md。

输入 release.json 只读不改；两个产物都由本脚本产生，不手写。

阶段/流量/观察时长/回滚条件来自团队已批准并被 memory_search 取回的生产发布策略
（记忆条目 release:production-policy，origin=platform-approved，未被任何证据推翻）：
"生产发布采用 5%、25%、100% 三阶段；每阶段观察 15 分钟；
5xx_rate > 1% 或 p95_ms > 800 立即回滚。" 三个分句以 ； 分隔，回滚条件这个语义单元是
"5xx_rate > 1% 或 p95_ms > 800 立即回滚"，句末 。 属于整句而非该条件；题面要求逐字复用，
故原文照抄，不翻译、不改写、不弱化，并在每个阶段完整重复。
"""
import csv
import hashlib
import json
import os

# 已批准策略的三个分句（逐字抄自记忆条目）
POLICY_TRAFFIC = ["5", "25", "100"]
POLICY_OBSERVE_MINUTES = "15"
POLICY_ROLLBACK = "5xx_rate > 1% 或 p95_ms > 800 立即回滚"

COLUMNS = ["stage", "traffic_percent", "observe_minutes", "rollback_condition"]
NOTE_FIELDS = ["service", "version", "target", "artifact_sha256", "database_migration"]


def build_rows():
    rows = []
    for index, traffic in enumerate(POLICY_TRAFFIC, start=1):
        # 回滚条件在每阶段完整重复，且每阶段都是同一句原文
        rows.append([str(index), traffic, POLICY_OBSERVE_MINUTES, POLICY_ROLLBACK])
    return rows


def main():
    with open("release.json", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        release = json.load(handle)
    missing = [field for field in NOTE_FIELDS if not release.get(field)]
    assert not missing, f"release.json 缺字段: {missing}"

    os.makedirs("out", exist_ok=True)
    rows = build_rows()
    with open("out/rollout.csv", "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as handle:
        writer = csv.writer(handle)
        writer.writerow(COLUMNS)
        writer.writerows(rows)

    note = ["# 发布说明 " + release["service"] + " " + release["version"], ""]
    note += [f"- {field}: {release[field]}" for field in NOTE_FIELDS]
    note += ["", f"- rollout_artifact: out/rollout.csv（{len(rows)} 阶段，流量 {'/'.join(POLICY_TRAFFIC)}%）",
             f"- observe_minutes: {POLICY_OBSERVE_MINUTES}",
             f"- rollback_condition: {POLICY_ROLLBACK}",
             "- policy_source: 团队已批准的生产发布策略（持久记忆 release:production-policy）", ""]
    with open("release_note.md", "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        handle.write("\n".join(note))

    # ---- 核对：把产物读回来，逐字段比对策略与 release.json ----
    with open("out/rollout.csv", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as handle:
        back = list(csv.reader(handle))
    assert back[0] == COLUMNS, back[0]
    assert back[1:] == rows, back[1:]
    assert [r[1] for r in back[1:]] == POLICY_TRAFFIC
    assert all(r[2] == POLICY_OBSERVE_MINUTES for r in back[1:])
    assert all(r[3] == POLICY_ROLLBACK for r in back[1:]), "回滚条件被改写/翻译即不合规"
    assert all(r[3].startswith("5xx_rate") and "或" in r[3] and r[3].endswith("立即回滚") for r in back[1:])
    with open("release_note.md", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        text = handle.read()
    for field in NOTE_FIELDS:
        assert release[field] in text, f"release_note.md 未写明 {field}"
    digest = hashlib.sha256(open("out/rollout.csv", "rb").read()).hexdigest()
    print("rollout stages:", len(back) - 1, "| columns:", ",".join(back[0]))
    print("rollback_condition verbatim:", back[1][3])
    print("release_note fields ok for:", ", ".join(NOTE_FIELDS))
    print("inputs untouched:", sorted(os.listdir(".")))
    print("out/rollout.csv sha256:", digest)


main()

本次生产发布身份（来源：release.json 实读 + scripts/make_rollout.py 生成并核对的产物）：service=checkout version=v3.2.1 target=production artifact_sha256=8d73c33d9f5a database_migration=expand-only。灰度按已批准策略执行：out/rollout.csv 三阶段 5%/25%/100%、每阶段观察 15 分钟，回滚条件逐字复用策略原文（持久记忆 release:production-policy，未被证据推翻，故只引用不修正）：5xx_rate > 1% 或 p95_ms > 800 立即回滚。后续审计以本条定位这次具体发布；脚本 scripts/make_rollout.py 只是生成器位置，不是发布事实本身。
